items.title: NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: PROPOSED SETTLERS GROVE STREET-LIGHTING DISTRICT
items.summary: Notice is hereby given that the Wayne Township Board of Trustees will hold a public hearing regarding a petition requesting the establishment of a street-lighting district for the Settlers Grove subdivision pursuant to Chapter 515 of the Ohio Revised Code. Date: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 Time: 7:30 p.m. Location: Wayne Township Administration Building 6050 North Clarksville Road Waynesville, Ohio…
